distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) and Lau (2025) support Hong Kong occurrence. Smith et al. (2022) independently reports Hong Kong and adds Yunnan, with locality evidence from Wenshan and Honghe. Mainland China is therefore promoted to Present, and the reviewed distribution is Yunnan + Hong Kong.

host_note: Albizia, Camellia, Dimocarpus, and Lansium are retained at genus level from Smith et al. (2020). Smith et al. (2022) provides no host in the curated record, so no host update is made.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Coptodryas concinna (Beeson, 1930).
